paragraphs: R’ Yose (without further designation) ben Chalafta, the well-known sage. Rabbi Shmuel ben Chalafta: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 3, end of halakhah 5.
Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta: the Mishnah, end of Uktzin.[^1]

notes.text: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5 names Rabbi Shmuel bar Chalafta, and Mishnah Uktzin 3:12 names Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta. Hyman’s statement about Yose ben Chalafta is retained; its abbreviated title is left as R’.
